issues.finding: The model is named M_1 although every satisfaction clause in the example refers to M; the displayed O is a single sphere family, not the function from worlds to sphere families required by the model definition.
issues.proposed_resolution: Name the model M consistently and identify the displayed family as O_w, leaving other centers' sphere families implicit and freely completable.

issues.location: failure of the contraposed counterfactual, source lines 59–61
issues.finding: Failure of the material counterpart in one admitting sphere does not by itself refute the counterfactual; under the stated valuation this outer sphere is the only not-q-admitting sphere. The text stops without explicitly concluding falsity of the counterfactual.
issues.proposed_resolution: State the sphere's uniqueness and the resulting falsity of the contraposed counterfactual at the center.
